model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss, comparing several lines with different characteristics. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and employs a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. A purple solid line, labeled "Vanilla", begins at a value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.65 at iteration 140000. A blue solid line, also labeled "StrmLLM", starts at approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. An orange solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", extends from approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. A green solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", begins at approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. A red solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starts at approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. A dark blue solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", begins at approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000.
